name: bookland.ge
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1828 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.
lesson: Serve sitemap.xml from the same host as the pages it lists, and name it in robots.txt.
summary: bookland.ge scores 50 out of 100 (F). 9 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: 1828 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 1828 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: 195.54.179.167 (1828). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://bookland.ge.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 51 form controls have no label
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 20 elements on /, /login?returnUrl=%2F, /passwordrecovery, for example .has-children.mm-nav-item:nth-child(6) > a > .category-name and .nav-menu > .mm-nav-item:nth-child(7) > a > .category-name. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 2 pages, ChatGPT-User cannot read 2 pages, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 2 pages, Claude-User cannot read 2 pages.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

fix.title: 2 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 9.1.0 (banner of /js/-bjjdc-frhnxvpobqckneq.scripts.js?v=VjZnzlJsfn9g_JRG8RBWzuoqRbU): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-27212. Swiper versions >=6.5.1 and <12.1.2 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution that bypasses a previous…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 12.1.2 or later; upgrade jQuery Validation to 1.20.0 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /login?returnUrl=%2F, /passwordrecovery, /register?returnUrl=%2F, /%E1%83%A4%E1%83%90%E1%83%A1%E1%83%93%E1%83%90%E1%83%99%E1%83%9A%E1%83%94%E1%83%91%E1%83%94%E1%83%91%E1%83%98 and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text…
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 1.8 s
